name: Static Contiguous Image-Based Partitioning
definition: A parallelization strategy for volume rendering that divides the image into contiguous blocks assigned to processors to avoid the cost of replicated ray casting for shared pixels, which occurs in adaptive image sampling.
summary: Static Contiguous Image-Based Partitioning is a parallel volume rendering strategy that divides the image into static tiles to eliminate synchronization overhead and avoid replicated ray casting at boundaries.
